metaTitle: Jaguar Nationwide Engine Recovery | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Jaguar engine recovery service covering the UK. Flatbed transport, secure collection, and delivery to our Essex workshop. Get a quote for nationwide recovery today.
lede: If your Jaguar won't start or can't be driven safely, we arrange flatbed recovery from anywhere in the UK to our workshop in Essex.

blocks.html: We arrange nationwide flatbed transport for any Jaguar model that cannot be driven safely to our workshop. The service covers:

items: Prompt collection from your home, roadside, or another garage.
Secure loading onto a flatbed transporter – the only method recommended by Jaguar.
Safe transport with full insurance cover and real-time tracking.
Direct delivery to our workshop for inspection and repair.

blocks.html: We handle all logistics, including manual release of electronic parking brakes and gearbox neutral where needed, ensuring your Jaguar arrives without additional damage.

sections.heading: Get a Quote for Jaguar Recovery

paras: Cost depends on your location and vehicle condition. [Contact us for a fixed-price quote](/contact) before we arrange collection.

blocks.html: We recover every Jaguar model – from classics to the latest F-Pace. Here are some we routinely handle:
Recovery is available for all engine types – [ask us](/contact) if your model isn't listed.

steps.body: Call or use our online form. We'll ask about your Jaguar's condition, location, and whether it's driveable. We then determine the right recovery vehicle.
We assign the nearest flatbed transporter. You'll receive a live ETA and tracking details so you know exactly when to expect the driver.
Our driver performs a pre-load vehicle inspection, then uses a winch and hydraulic bed to load your Jaguar. It's strapped down using approved tie-down points to prevent any movement in transit.
Your Jaguar is driven directly to our Billericay workshop. We unload, perform an arrival inspection, and confirm safe delivery. From there, we can proceed with inspection or repair.

steps.body: We take your details and assess the recovery need.
We provide a fixed price and arrange a collection time.
A flatbed collects your Jaguar and brings it to our workshop.

blocks.html: Read our blog: [From recovery to road test – the full journey](/guides)

items.q: What types of Jaguar can you recover?
items.a: Every Jaguar model – from classic XJ to the latest F-Pace. We handle saloons, estates, coupes, and SUVs.

items.q: Do you use flatbed or tow trucks?
items.a: We always use flatbed transporters – the only method Jaguar recommends. This protects your transmission and prevents damage to the body.

items.q: How quickly can you collect my Jaguar?
items.a: For urgent cases we can often arrange same-day collection. Standard recovery is usually within 24-48 hours, depending on your location.

items.q: What if my Jaguar has an electronic parking brake?
items.a: Our drivers are trained to manually release the EPB and put the gearbox in neutral – we follow Jaguar's official procedures for each model.

items.q: Is my Jaguar insured during transport?
items.a: Yes, full insurance cover is included for the duration of the recovery.

items.q: Can you recover a Jaguar that's not starting at all?
items.a: Absolutely. We use winches and hydraulic beds to load non-starters safely.
